title: In-memory session store expiring on a monotonic clock
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag using >= for expiry as expiring sessions early. The contract is explicit: valid only while elapsed is strictly less than the TTL, so at exactly the TTL the session is expired, and the check asserts both sides of that boundary with an injected monotonic clock.
